assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and three key-area boundaries are maintainer-defined provisional rough boundaries (geometry_role=provisional_constraint, official_boundary=false), calibrated to the announced ~11.4 sq km overall design area and announced key-area areas.
assumptions.impact: All spatial conclusions, area metrics and ratios are concept-level and will be fully recomputed when official geometry is published; they are not official redlines or approval bases.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Floor area ratio, building height, building density, setback and facility standards are not present in the public site package; related metrics are marked status=unknown.
assumptions.impact: No development-intensity conclusion in this package may be read as an approved control; building footprints are capacity illustrations only.

assumptions.statement: Existing building registers, land ownership, heritage protection scopes and municipal pipeline data are not available in the repository.
assumptions.impact: Retain-renovate-demolish classification is a method plus a to-be-calibrated list, not parcel-level conclusions; heritage-related design is limited to narrative and public-realm concepts.

assumptions.statement: Annual events, scenario open days, AI pilots (robot delivery, slow-mobility navigation, heritage guide) and brand operations are concept suggestions, not confirmed government activities.
assumptions.impact: Operators, data boundaries, safety plans and copyright clearance must be established by implementers before any activity; no personal data collection is assumed anywhere in the package.

assumptions.statement: The package is delivered under bilingual contract v1: proposal.en.md, report/proposal.en.html, visual/index.en.html, English drawings and English figure counterparts mirror the Chinese primary content, using the event terminology glossary where applicable.
assumptions.impact: Translation equivalence of claims, metrics and figure positions should still be compared by human reviewers.
